definitions.gloss: to establish, to found, to set up
definitions.explanation: To create or establish something significant and lasting, such as a theory, a dynasty, or a new standard. Carries a sense of building something from the ground up with determination.
To achieve or set a notable record or accomplishment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{理論|りろん}→理論：04708_riron⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{立|た}てた。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦スタイル→スタイル：03851_sutairu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{立|た}てた⟦{画家|がか}→画家：02583_gaka⟧だ。
examples.english: He is a painter who established his own unique style.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧⟦{戦|たたか}い→戦い：02070_tatakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{末|すえ}→末：03362_sue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{国家|こっか}→国家：02760_kokka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{立|た}てた。
examples.english: After a long struggle, they founded a new nation.

examples.japanese: {世界新記録|せかいしんきろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{立|た}てた。
examples.english: She set a new world record.

examples.japanese: {今季|こんき}⟦{最多|さいた}→最多：28216_saita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{得点記録|とくてんきろく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{立|た}てた。
examples.english: He set the highest scoring record this season.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}→誰：00534_dare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{破|やぶ}れない→破れる：02322_yabureru⟧⟦{記録|きろく}→記録：02490_kiroku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{打|う}ち{立|た}てること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧だ。
examples.english: My goal is to set a record that no one can break.

notes:
{打|う}ち{立|た}てる conveys establishing something with force and determination. It is more emphatic than simple ⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ and implies creating something significant or groundbreaking.
